issue_context.title: Promote health API from internal to GA (generally available)
issue_context.body:
### Description

We've been working on the health API for a while and the breaking changes have slowed to the point where we can promote the API away from the `/_internal` categorization.
comments: The health API will be GA under the endpoint `_health_report`.

review_comments: Out of curiosity, should we just *add* `/_health` and `/_health/{indicator}` to the paths so we have a period during which both URLs work? Then at a later time (9.x?) we can remove the `/_internal/health` path?

That's a very interesting idea.
I do worry that not ALL our `_internal` APIs will be internal/experimental/not-GA anymore should we choose to do this though. The current invariant of `DO NOT USE` for the `_internal` APIs (irrespective of reading the docs) is quite valuable IMO.
edit: hmm, although we wouldn't document the `_internal` path
